excerpt: Welcome to bizfile California, the Secretary of State’s online portal to help businesses file, search, and order business records.
User Access allows the entity to control who is authorized to submit online filings on behalf of the entity.
If you are a requestor of Bulk data, the new entity numbers will be reflected in the files.
Entities that file a continuing conversion (e.g., Corporation to LLC or LP) will keep their original number as well.
File a Financing Statement or Lien Document
Search for Debtor and Secured Party Information
Register a Trademark/Service Mark
Search for Registered Trademarks and Service Marks
Verify Issuance of an Apostille
Download list of active Notaries Public
Online Certified Copy Verification
Over 140 Business Filings, Name Reservations, and Orders for Certificates of Status and Certified Copies of Corporations, Limited Liability Companies and Limited Partnerships available online.
All business forms can be submitted by mail or in person.
Free online access to over 17 million corporate, limited liability company and limited partnership images is available online
certificates of status are available within minutes online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov.
Customers can print plain copies of business entity documents online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov including formation/registration, amendments, terminations and statements of information.
The disclosed information and a copy of the filing can be viewed on the Secretary of State's Advanced Publicly Traded Disclosure Search.
Statements of Information, Common Interest Development Statements and Publicly Traded Disclosure Statements can be filed online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov.
Fastest Service is provided online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov including 24-Hour Expedite ($350) and Same-Day ($750).
A customer may submit a business entity document for preclearance prior to an intended filing date, requesting completion of preclearance within 24 hours.
4–Hour Filing Service (Class A) - $500.00: Drop-Off-Only in Sacramento. Filing response guaranteed within 4 hours
The California Secretary of State is offering voters a way to track and receive notifications on the status of their vote-by-mail ballot.

California is moving filings behind entity-linked accounts, stated on its own page: "Effective August 1, 2026, web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings. The option to file a Statement of Information online will only be visible to users with access established."
The stated reason for the new account wall is anti-automation by design: "Establishing User Access will help in preventing unauthorized submissions or filings on your entity's record."
